description: Pillar overrides for Technology. Replaces the Operations/Governance area with Data Privacy & Ethics, the defining regulatory challenge for tech companies.

operations.label: Data Privacy & Ethics
operations.description_override: Govern data use, AI ethics, and user privacy across your technology platform.

privacy_by_design.title: Privacy-by-Design Architecture
privacy_by_design.description: Rebuild data pipelines with privacy-by-design principles, GDPR/PDPA compliance built-in, and a user data rights portal.

ai_ethics_board.title: AI Ethics Advisory Board
ai_ethics_board.description: Establish an independent AI ethics board with external civil society members. Publish quarterly algorithmic impact assessments.

compliance_minimum.title: Minimum Regulatory Compliance
compliance_minimum.description: Meet GDPR/PDPA minimums only. No proactive ethics governance.
